Name: Easier crafting - upgrade everything
Author: bananasalmon
Description:
Okay, maybe you will not be able to upgrade [i]everything[/i], but you will be able to upgrade a whopping 29 items! Become more sustainable in Stardew Valley by upgrading items into better versions, instead of crafting everything from scratch and filling up all your chests! This idea was inspired by More Transmutations and other crafting mods that focus on only a selection of items.

[b][size=3]How to get them[/size][/b]
Have 30 crafting recipes added to the game on top of the original ones, nothing is replaced or lost. Of these, 27 are gained simultaneously with the original, 2 new recipes can be purchased from Clint and 1 new recipe can be purchased from the Dwarf.
Of the 26, 17 are gained when leveling up a skill, and 8 when purchasing a recipe.
For now however, when purchasing a recipe, the additional recipe is usually not granted immediately, and if not, you will receive them in the mail the day after. 
The mail can come from 4 sources: SCIENCYS, CA, or Joja, plus the alternative Deluxe Scarecrow recipe can come from the same source as the original, namely the Z.C. Rarecrow Society.

[b][size=3]Options and compatibility[/size]
[/b]Can be installed anytime! Recipes gained from leveling skills are granted instantly when opening your game and you are skilled enough.
Besides the mail, you can also configure which recipes you want and which not, to ensure compatibility with existing crafting mods. By compatibility I mean not having (more or less) the same recipes twice. It does not break other mods that add recipes, like More Transmutations.
If you are not running other crafting mods, it is recommended to enable all recipes since they do not break anything and just give you more ways to craft the 'deluxe' items. You don't have to use them all, you only have some extra recipes to craft for perfection!

Feel free to let me know if this mod creates any infinite money loopholes, if you think some recipes make it too easy, or if some recipes are too hard. Or if you have suggestions to improve the mod, or new upgrade recipes!

[b][size=3]Credit[/size][/b]
Recipes by me, trying to balance price and strength of all items. Any duplicate recipes with existing crafting mods are because more people can have the same idea. When trying to keep things balanced there is not much room for creativity.
